value.rationale: An exact all-time four-point sign-and-zero theorem for arbitrary finite cooperative active networks yields a physically interpretable common-source ancestry test under any spatially correlated Gaussian background. Gaussian OU noise with exactly matched two-time covariance is indistinguishable at quadratic order but always distinguishable on common-source quadruples. Explicit disconnected/noise-correlated and anti-cooperative boundary examples show nontrivial structural scope rather than a renamed one-particle cumulant.
